title: Scenes & rendering
description: Create meshes, materials and cameras with WebGPU rendering and a WebGL2 fallback. Includes the embedded Rust/Wasm transform kernel.
requirements: WebGPU or WebGL2 · Wasm SIMD and DecompressionStream gzip · no Rust installation
keywords: base engine cube box geometry pbr instancing picking orbit camera controls transforms hierarchy
exampleNote: Create a mesh, give it a material and animate its rotation. Falls back to WebGL2 when needed.

title: Machinery & CAD
description: Add joints, gear and piston couplings, exploded views, section cuts, dimensions and STL/OBJ ingestion to your assemblies.
requirements: Requires core 0.1.0 · joints and CAD tools support both backends · section rendering needs WebGPU
keywords: conveyor rollers motor gears piston robot arm industrial kinematics revolute prismatic ik stl obj cad metrology measurements cutting caps annotations assembly
imports:
import { Engine, box, PbrMaterial } from '@scottcampbelldata/vexel-core';
import { Kinematics } from '@scottcampbelldata/vexel-machinery';
exampleNote: Animate a revolute joint with Kinematics. Version 0.1.0 supplies machinery tools; a ready-made conveyor factory and STEP/IGES import are not included.

title: 3D model loading
description: Load static glTF and GLB models, preserve named nodes and share primitive geometry.
requirements: Requires core 0.1.0 · static, uncompressed models · skins, animation and required extensions are unsupported
keywords: model asset import loader gltf glb 3d file mesh parse download
imports:
import { Engine } from '@scottcampbelldata/vexel-core';
import { loadGLTF, parseGLTF } from '@scottcampbelldata/vexel-gltf';
exampleNote: Parse a tiny built-in glTF model without downloading an asset. For your own file, use loadGLTF(engine, '/model.glb').

title: Particles & effects
description: Add GPU particles, wind obstacles, toon shading, procedural atmosphere, HDR targets and post-processing.
requirements: Requires core 0.1.0 · WebGPU hardware · HTTPS or localhost
keywords: leaves sparks particles wind atmosphere sky fog scattering bloom grain bokeh toon hdr postprocessing effects vfx
imports:
import { Engine } from '@scottcampbelldata/vexel-core';
import { GPUParticles } from '@scottcampbelldata/vexel-creative';
exampleNote: Run 2,000 particles with wind and curl. This example requires WebGPU; it explains how to proceed when WebGPU is unavailable.

title: React components
description: Build scenes with Canvas, meshes, geometry and materials. Use stable refs and useFrame to animate without React state updates.
requirements: Requires core 0.1.0 · React 18 or 19 · Canvas manages engine setup and disposal
keywords: react jsx tsx components canvas useframe hooks ref next nextjs vite ui
imports: import { Canvas, Mesh, BoxGeometry, PbrMaterial, useFrame } from '@scottcampbelldata/vexel-react';
exampleNote: Render and animate a cube with Canvas and useFrame. Uses React.createElement so the complete HTML example runs without a JSX build step.
